an0071.user: Home-care brand, newish to ads, running Meesho. I'm confused — post-iOS, the ad platform says my ROAS is 4.3, but Shopify's last-click attribution says 1.9. ₹15.5L spent last month. Which dashboard is the real one I should trust?
an0071.assistant:
Neither is 'the real one' — and learning why now will save you a lot of confusion later. They measure the same sales by different rules, so they'll never match.

The platform's 4.3 is the optimist. After Apple's privacy changes it can't see every conversion, so it estimates them, and it credits any sale within 7 days of a click — which means it claims credit generously, including for sales it only nudged. Shopify's last-click 1.9 is the pessimist. It hands the entire sale to whatever the customer clicked last, usually a search for your brand name or a direct visit, and gives the ad that first introduced them zero credit. The truth lives between 1.9 and 4.3. Both are 'right' from their own angle; neither is the answer.

So stop trying to crown one and use a number neither can distort: blended CAC. Take everything you spent — ₹15.5L — and divide by the actual count of new customers Shopify recorded last month. That's your honest, all-in cost to buy a customer. Compare it to what a customer is worth to you, and you'll know if ₹15.5L was well spent, regardless of what either ROAS claims.

For now, write down your blended CAC each month and track it. It's the one figure the dashboards can't argue you out of.
